title: MiMo-Embodied: X-Embodied Foundation Model Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 跨具身多模态模型与自动驾驶训练技术报告
best_for_zh: 研究 embodied/driving 数据对象、规则奖励、轨迹规划、传感器隐私与 open-loop 安全审计的读者
one_line: MiMo-Embodied stages embodied, driving, generated-CoT, and deterministic-GRPO supervision, then separately studies NAVSIM IL+DiffGRPO, but discloses no training scale, mixtures, immutable splits, sensor ledger, rollouts, or planner artifacts.
MiMo-Embodied 以四阶段课程串联 embodied、driving、generated-CoT 与规则 GRPO，并另行研究 NAVSIM IL+DiffGRPO；但训练规模/比例、不可变 split、传感器账本、rollout 与 planner artifact 均未披露。
why: It maps heterogeneous embodied data objects into one curriculum while showing why offline geometric rewards, open-loop planning, and open weights do not substitute for provenance, privacy, closed-loop safety, and environment verification.
inclusion_reason: A cross-embodiment report spanning affordance, spatial, action, driving, and trajectory objects in a four-stage SFT-to-CoT-to-rule-GRPO curriculum, with a separate NAVSIM planner path and major disclosure gaps around scale, splits, privacy, safety, and artifacts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
MiMo-Embodied asks whether one vision-language foundation model can transfer across object affordance, egocentric planning, spatial grounding, autonomous-driving perception, status prediction, and trajectory planning. Its data objects range from text answers and action choices to points, masks, 2D/3D boxes, calibrated-camera geometry, CoT rationales, and continuous ego trajectories.

The work was released in 2025 as an arXiv preprint. Official paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.16518

The report organizes these objects into four main stages: general-plus-embodied SFT, carried-forward data plus driving SFT, carried-forward data plus generated CoT SFT, and deterministic-rule GRPO. A distinct downstream NAVSIM experiment adds imitation learning and DiffGRPO to a diffusion trajectory planner. These two RL settings should not be conflated.

The strongest disclosure is the task/source map and training order. The weakest is exposure accounting: no selected sample, image, frame, hour, token, CoT, trajectory, or rollout total is given, and no stage mixture or immutable split manifest is released.

MiMo-Embodied 研究视觉语言基础模型能否在物体可供性、第一视角规划、空间定位、自动驾驶感知、状态预测与轨迹规划之间迁移。其数据对象从文本答案、动作选择延伸到点、掩码、2D/3D 框、标定相机几何、CoT 理由与连续自车轨迹。

报告把这些对象组织为四个主阶段：通用+具身 SFT、继承前序数据并加入驾驶 SFT、继承前序数据并加入生成式 CoT SFT、确定性规则 GRPO。独立的 NAVSIM 下游实验则为扩散轨迹规划器加入模仿学习与 DiffGRPO；两种 RL 设定不能混为一谈。

报告最充分的披露是任务/来源映射与训练顺序，最薄弱的是暴露量核算：未给出入选样本数、图像数、帧数、时长、token、CoT、轨迹或采样展开总数，也未发布各阶段的混合比例与不可变的数据划分清单。

本文是 2025 年发布的 arXiv 预印本，官方页面为 https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.16518。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core idea is staged cross-domain transfer. Stage 1 binds general multimodal competence to affordance, planning, and spatial records. Stage 2 retains earlier data while adding driving views, hazards, intent, road geometry, and high-level decisions. Stage 3 adds explicit reasoning about situations, alternatives, constraints, risk, trajectories, and justification. Stage 4 applies group-relative policy optimization to records with rule-checkable answers.

Main GRPO rewards exact multiple-choice answers, box IoU, whether a point lies in the target mask, and strict output templates. These rewards are deterministic enough for RLVR at the label level, but they verify neither physical task completion nor collision-free, comfortable, legally compliant driving.

The NAVSIM branch is a separate construction: MiMo features condition a denoising diffusion trajectory policy, imitation learning initializes it, and DiffGRPO improves offline planner metrics. The report does not publish its reward, simulator revision, rollouts, code, or checkpoints.

核心思想是分阶段跨领域迁移。第 1 阶段把通用多模态能力连接到可供性、规划与空间记录；第 2 阶段保留前序数据并加入驾驶视图、危险、意图、道路几何与高层决策；第 3 阶段加入情境、备选方案、约束、风险、轨迹与论证的显式推理；第 4 阶段对可用规则检查答案的数据执行组相对策略优化。

主 GRPO 奖励包括选择题精确匹配、框 IoU、点是否落在目标掩码内，以及严格的输出格式。这些信号在标签层级足够确定，可归入 RLVR，但不能验证物理任务是否完成，也不能证明驾驶过程无碰撞、舒适或符合法规。

NAVSIM 分支采用独立构造：MiMo 特征为去噪扩散轨迹策略提供条件，模仿学习用于初始化策略，DiffGRPO 改善离线规划器指标。其奖励、模拟器版本、采样展开、代码与 checkpoint 未发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
All model components initialize from MiMo-VL 7B-SFT-2508. Stage 1 mixes inherited general data with PixMo-Points, RoboAfford, RoboRefIt, planning sources derived from BridgeData V2, RoboVQA, AgiBot and HoloAssist, egocentric sources, SQA3D, self-curated 3D grounding, VLM-3R, RefSpatial, and EmbSpatial-SFT.

Stage 2 carries those data forward and adds autonomous-driving sources spanning perception, participant intent and interaction, meta-actions, traffic knowledge, justification, and planning. Named families include CODA-LM, LingoQA-style sessions, DriveLM, OmniDrive, nuScenes-QA, MME-RealWorld, IDKB, MAPLM, DriveAction, and NuInstruct.

Stage 3 generates CoT for situation analysis, candidate solutions, alternatives, affordance/spatial constraints, risk, trajectory evaluation, and justification. The generator identity, prompts, decoding, source subset, trace count, filtering, correctness verification, and rejected records are unknown.

Stages 1-3 train all components with batch 512, AdamW, learning rate 2e-6, weight decay 0.05, cosine scheduling, and 32,768 context. Stage 4 uses batch 32, learning rate 1e-6, weight decay 0, the same optimizer/schedule/context, and all components. Epochs, steps, warmup, precision, hardware, compute, and seeds remain undisclosed.

全部模型组件均从 MiMo-VL 7B-SFT-2508 初始化。第 1 阶段把继承的通用数据与 PixMo-Points、RoboAfford、RoboRefIt，来自 BridgeData V2/RoboVQA/AgiBot/HoloAssist 的规划来源、第一视角来源、SQA3D、自建 3D 定位数据、VLM-3R、RefSpatial 与 EmbSpatial-SFT 混合。

第 2 阶段继承这些数据，并加入覆盖感知、参与者意图/交互、元动作、交通知识、论证与规划的自动驾驶来源，包括 CODA-LM、LingoQA 式会话、DriveLM、OmniDrive、nuScenes-QA、MME-RealWorld、IDKB、MAPLM、DriveAction 与 NuInstruct。

第 3 阶段为情境分析、候选方案、备选方案、可供性/空间约束、风险、轨迹评估与论证生成 CoT。生成器身份、提示词、解码方式、来源子集、推理轨迹数量、过滤、正确性验证与被拒记录均未知。

第 1–3 阶段的全参数训练采用批大小 512、AdamW、学习率 2e-6、权重衰减 0.05、余弦调度、32,768 上下文；第 4 阶段采用批大小 32、学习率 1e-6、权重衰减 0、相同的优化器/调度/上下文设置与全参数训练。训练轮次、步数、预热、精度、硬件、计算量与随机种子未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The report evaluates 17 embodied and 12 driving benchmarks, but their metrics range from accuracy and geometric scores to text overlap, external pipelines, and learned judges. This breadth is evidence of coverage, not one uniform verification contract.

For the cross-domain curriculum ablation, staged training reports 62.4 embodied average and 63.3 driving performance, versus 58.4 and 55.2 for joint non-staged training at approximately equal loss tokens. Exact tokens, runs, variance, seeds, and statistical tests are absent, so the result remains conditional on the paper setup.

In NAVSIM, Table 6 reports PDMS 86.5 for MiMo-Embodied, 87.4 after imitation learning, and 91.0 after IL plus DiffGRPO, with 796 input tokens. These are offline author-reported planner metrics; no reward implementation, environment revision, predictions, code, or derived checkpoint is available.

The proprietary trajectory experiment uses five front-camera frames at 2 Hz to predict three seconds of ego-coordinate motion and measures open-loop L2 error. It provides no dataset size, geography, dates, sensors, split, absolute results, privacy controls, or closed-loop evaluation.

The official evaluation suite is not fully self-contained. LingoQA loads a local text-classification model, thresholds its score at 0.5, and leaves the checkpoint path as /path/to/your/Lingo-Judge-safetensors. Therefore the exact judge and paper-score reproduction remain unresolved.

报告评测 17 个具身基准与 12 个驾驶基准，但所用指标混合了准确率、几何分数、文本重叠、外部流程与学习式评判器。这种广度只能说明覆盖范围，不能视为统一的验证契约。

跨领域课程消融中，分阶段训练报告具身平均分为 62.4、驾驶得分为 63.3；在损失计算所用 token 数近似相同的情况下，非分阶段联合训练的相应结果为 58.4 与 55.2。精确 token 数、实验运行次数、方差、随机种子与统计检验缺失，因此结论只在论文设置下成立。

NAVSIM 表 6 报告 MiMo-Embodied 的 PDMS 为 86.5，模仿学习后为 87.4，IL+DiffGRPO 后为 91.0，输入为 796 token。这些是作者报告的离线规划器指标；奖励实现、环境版本、预测输出、代码与衍生 checkpoint 均未发布。

专有轨迹实验使用 2 Hz 的 5 帧前视摄像头图像预测 3 秒自车坐标系运动，并测量开环 L2 误差。报告未给出数据集规模、地理范围、日期、传感器、数据划分、绝对结果、隐私控制或闭环评测。

官方评测套件并非完全自包含。LingoQA 加载本地文本分类模型，以 0.5 为阈值，默认 checkpoint 路径仍是占位路径 /path/to/your/Lingo-Judge-safetensors；因此精确评判器与论文分数的复现问题尚未解决。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
MiMo-Embodied's construction novelty is the shared curriculum across robotics-style affordance/spatial/action objects and driving perception/prediction/planning objects. Carry-forward staging makes transfer direction explicit and the approximately equal-token ablation gives limited evidence that ordering matters.

The main GRPO stage is notable for using simple deterministic rewards over heterogeneous outputs: exact labels, geometric overlap, containment, and format. This makes reward semantics legible, although thresholds, aggregation, invalid-output behavior, and rollouts are still missing.

The planner study adds another level of supervision by coupling VLM representations to a diffusion trajectory model, initializing with expert demonstrations, and optimizing NAVSIM metrics through DiffGRPO. Its separation from the main text-output GRPO is important: the latter does not contain a driving-safety reward.

The report also exposes a broad evaluation adapter layer, which is reusable for offline comparison. Yet external assets, official pipelines, and the LingoQA placeholder mean the suite is not an immutable, self-contained paper-run package.

MiMo-Embodied 的构造新意是用共享课程连接机器人式可供性/空间/动作对象与驾驶感知/预测/规划对象。逐阶段继承明确了迁移方向，近似等 token 消融则提供了有限证据，说明训练顺序可能重要。

主 GRPO 阶段用简单的确定性奖励覆盖异构输出：精确标签、几何重叠、包含关系与格式。这使奖励语义较清晰，但阈值、聚合方式、无效输出处理与采样展开仍缺失。

规划器实验通过把 VLM 表征接入扩散轨迹模型、用专家示范初始化，再以 DiffGRPO 优化 NAVSIM 指标，引入另一层监督。它与主要的文本输出 GRPO 必须分开：后者不含驾驶安全奖励。

报告还开放了广泛的评测适配层，便于离线比较；但外部资源、官方流程与 LingoQA 占位路径意味着该套件并不是不可变、自包含的论文运行包。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
No training scale or mixture is disclosed. Named upstream counts such as RoboRefIt's original scenes do not reveal how many records MiMo selected, duplicated, filtered, replayed, or weighted. Without per-stage media, tokens, CoT, trajectories, and RL rollouts, exposure and domain balance cannot be audited.

Same-source train/evaluation risk is material. Many training families reappear as evaluation families or close derivatives, and inherited MiMo-VL exposure is unknown. No row, media, perceptual, temporal, scene, route, subject, geography, or synthetic-derivative manifest establishes clean separation.

Rule rewards are not environment safety. Exact answers, IoU, point-in-mask, and format checks do not verify manipulation stability, navigation completion, collision avoidance, comfort, traffic compliance, uncertainty calibration, or fail-safe behavior. The NAVSIM branch lacks released rewards, simulator revision, rollouts, planner code, and checkpoints.

Open-loop evidence cannot establish closed-loop or sim-to-real robustness. NAVSIM is offline/non-reactive, proprietary trajectories use open-loop L2, and “real-world” robot evidence is qualitative target-point visualization rather than controlled execution. Reactive actors, sensor failures, actuator dynamics, distribution shift, and compounding errors remain untested.

Proprietary driving and egocentric media create unresolved privacy and governance risks involving faces, plates, bystanders, drivers, vulnerable road users, precise time/location, geography, retention, access, consent, annotation labor, redaction, and deletion. MIT/Apache code and weight labels do not grant rights to those records.

Stage-3 CoT may be plausible but unfaithful because its teacher, prompts, validation, and rejects are closed. LingoQA additionally depends on an unspecified classifier checkpoint. Finally, 7B branding conflicts with the 8B Hugging Face display, and the release does not reconcile parameter-count conventions or provide a clean immutable lineage.

训练规模与混合比例完全未披露。RoboRefIt 原始场景等上游数字不能说明 MiMo 选择、重复、过滤、重放或加权了多少记录。缺少各阶段的媒体、token、CoT、轨迹与 RL 采样展开数量，无法审计暴露量与领域平衡。

同源训练/评测风险显著。多个训练数据家族以同名或近似衍生版本再次出现在评测中，继承的 MiMo-VL 数据暴露情况也未知。没有行级、媒体、感知、时间、场景、路线、主体、地理或合成衍生数据清单能够证明严格隔离。

规则奖励不等于环境安全。精确答案、IoU、点是否落在掩码内与格式检查不能验证操作稳定性、导航完成情况、碰撞规避、舒适性、交通规则遵从、不确定性校准或故障安全行为。NAVSIM 分支也未发布奖励、模拟器版本、采样展开、规划器代码与 checkpoint。

开环证据不能证明闭环性能或从模拟到现实的稳健性。NAVSIM 是离线、非响应式评测，专有轨迹使用开环 L2 指标，“真实世界”机器人证据只是定性目标点可视化，而非受控执行。响应式参与者、传感器故障、执行器动力学、分布偏移与误差累积均未测试。

专有驾驶/第一视角媒体带来未解决的隐私与治理风险，包括人脸、车牌、旁观者、驾驶员、弱势道路使用者、精确时间/位置、地理范围、保留期限、访问权限、同意、标注劳动、脱敏与删除。MIT/Apache 代码/权重标签并不授予这些记录的使用权利。

第 3 阶段的 CoT 可能合理但不忠实，因为教师模型、提示词、验证与被拒数据均未公开；LingoQA 还依赖未指定的分类器 checkpoint。最后，7B 品牌与 Hugging Face 显示的 8B 存在冲突，发布说明未解释参数口径，也未提供清晰、不可变的数据谱系。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For dataset builders, the report offers a rich schema spanning media identity, camera calibration, grounding geometry, object state and affordance, history, goal, candidate actions, traffic intent, rationale, trajectory, reward components, and stage assignment. Reusable releases should preserve these joins rather than flattening records into text.

For RLVR researchers, main GRPO demonstrates how exact and geometric checks can cover heterogeneous multimodal outputs. Reproduction requires thresholds, reward weights, parsers, invalid-output handling, group size, rollout records, failure mining, and per-component logs.

For planning researchers, NAVSIM IL+DiffGRPO suggests a bridge from foundation-model features to continuous trajectories. Safety-relevant reuse needs the simulator/environment revision, diffusion policy, demonstrations, reward, route/scene splits, planner checkpoints, predictions, and closed-loop follow-up.

For auditors, the card provides a checklist for shared-source leakage and sensor governance. Video/scene/route identities, inherited base exposures, derivative QA links, geography, subjects, precise location/time, redaction, consent, access, retention, and takedown should be first-class metadata.

The public checkpoint and evaluation adapters support inference and partial offline benchmarking. They do not reconstruct any training stage, CoT generation, main RL, DiffGRPO, proprietary data, closed-loop environment, or planner artifact, so exact reproduction and safety validation remain unavailable.

对数据集构建者，报告提供了丰富的字段模式：媒体标识、相机标定、定位几何、物体状态/可供性、历史、目标、候选动作、交通意图、理由、轨迹、奖励组件与阶段归属。可复用发布应保留这些关联关系，而不是把记录压平成文本。

对 RLVR 研究者，主 GRPO 展示了精确/几何校验如何覆盖异构多模态输出。复现需要阈值、奖励权重、解析器、无效输出处理、组大小、采样展开记录、失败案例挖掘与逐组件日志。

对规划研究者，NAVSIM IL+DiffGRPO 提出了从基础模型特征到连续轨迹的桥梁。安全相关复用需要模拟器/环境版本、扩散策略、示范数据、奖励、路线/场景划分、规划器 checkpoint、预测输出与后续闭环评测。

对审计者，本卡提供了共享来源泄漏与传感器治理清单：视频/场景/路线标识、继承的基础模型数据暴露、衍生问答关联、地理范围、主体、精确位置/时间、脱敏、同意、访问权限、保留期限与下架机制都应成为一等元数据。

公开 checkpoint 与评测适配器支持推理和部分离线基准评测，但不能重建任一训练阶段、CoT 生成、主 RL、DiffGRPO、专有数据、闭环环境或规划器产物；精确复现与安全验证仍不可用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the four main training stages distinct from the downstream NAVSIM IL+DiffGRPO planner experiment; read Sections 3.1–3.3 for the source families and Sections 4.1–4.4 with Table 1 for the four-stage curriculum and hyperparameters.
  • Read Section 5.2.2 with Table 6 for the separate NAVSIM IL+DiffGRPO planner; interpret NAVSIM and proprietary trajectory evidence as offline/open-loop, and the real-world robot figures as qualitative visualization.
  • Treat exact match, IoU, point-in-mask, and format as label-level rewards, not physical-task or driving-safety verification.
  • Do not infer MiMo-selected scale from upstream dataset statistics: selected counts, mixtures, CoT totals, trajectories, and rollouts are undisclosed, so the training stages and proprietary-data pipeline cannot be reconstructed from the release.
  • Use Appendix 8 and the official evaluation suite to inspect benchmark coverage: the LingoQA adapter retains a verified placeholder for the missing local judge checkpoint, and the 7B branding versus 8B metadata discrepancy remains unresolved. Related Cards: mimo-vl-2025, mimo-reasoning-pretraining-posttraining-2025, and gemini-robotics-physical-world-2025.

• 阅读第 3 节与表 1，核对四阶段训练顺序、各阶段的数据继承关系和已披露的训练超参数，并把四个主训练阶段与下游 NAVSIM IL+DiffGRPO 规划器实验分开。
  • 精确匹配、IoU、点是否落在掩码内与格式检查都是标签层级奖励，不是物理或驾驶安全验证。
  • 不要从上游数据集统计推断 MiMo 的实际入选规模；入选数量、混合比例、CoT 总量、轨迹与采样展开数量均未披露。
  • 阅读第 4 节与表 6，区分 NAVSIM 分支中的模仿学习、IL+DiffGRPO 结果与主训练流程；NAVSIM 与专有轨迹证据应解释为离线/开环证据，真实世界机器人图只属于定性可视化。
  • 对照附录和官方评测套件检查 LingoQA 评判器依赖；默认 checkpoint 路径 /path/to/your/Lingo-Judge-safetensors 已核实为官方评测代码中的占位路径，而非本卡模板残留或可用模型地址。LingoQA 复现仍需要缺失的评判器 checkpoint，7B 品牌与 8B 元数据之间的冲突也尚未解决。

相关卡片：mimo-vl-2025、mimo-reasoning-pretraining-posttraining-2025、gemini-robotics-physical-world-2025。

value.html: Stage 1 combines inherited MiMo-VL general data with embodied affordance, planning, and spatial sources. Stage 2 carries prior data forward and adds autonomous-driving perception, prediction, and planning sources. Stage 3 adds generated CoT over an undisclosed subset. Stage 4 uses an undisclosed curated rule-verifiable RL set. Selected counts, source ratios, versions, and rows are unknown.

value_zh.html: Stage 1 将继承的 MiMo-VL 通用数据与具身可供性、规划与空间来源结合。Stage 2 沿用先前数据并加入自动驾驶感知、预测与规划来源。Stage 3 在未披露子集上加入生成的 CoT。Stage 4 使用未披露的策展规则可验证 RL 集。所选计数、来源比例、版本与行未知。

value.html: Objects include captions, free-text or multiple-choice answers, points, masks, 2D/3D boxes, spatial relations, route and action plans, traffic intent, meta-actions, justifications, CoT rationales, and continuous future ego trajectories in downstream planner experiments.

value_zh.html: 对象包括配文、自由文本或选择题答案、点、掩码、2D/3D 框、空间关系、路线与动作规划、交通意图、元动作、论证、CoT 理由，以及下游规划器实验中的连续未来自车轨迹。

value.html: Public dataset authors and human annotators supply media, grounding labels, actions, justifications, and trajectories. DeepSeek-R1 generates long physical reasoning in Cosmos-Reason1. Automatically generated QA contributes to several sources. The Stage-3 CoT teacher is unknown. Expert human drivers supply proprietary demonstrations under undisclosed protocols.

value_zh.html: 公开数据集作者与人工标注者提供媒体、锚定标签、动作、论证与轨迹。DeepSeek-R1 在 Cosmos-Reason1 中生成长物理推理。自动生成 QA 贡献于若干来源。Stage-3 CoT 教师未知。专家人类驾驶员在未披露协议下提供专有示范。

value.html: Main SFT/GRPO operates on offline images, video, RGB-D, calibrated-camera, QA, grounding, and trajectory records, not an interactive robot or closed-loop driving environment. A separate downstream NAVSIM experiment trains a diffusion planner with imitation learning and DiffGRPO; proprietary trajectories are evaluated open loop.

value_zh.html: 主 SFT/GRPO 在离线图像、视频、RGB-D、标定相机、QA、锚定与轨迹记录上运行，而非交互机器人或闭环驾驶环境。单独的下游 NAVSIM 实验用模仿学习与 DiffGRPO 训练扩散规划器；专有轨迹以开环评测。

value.html: Main GRPO uses exact answer match for multiple-choice reasoning, box IoU, point-in-mask, and strict format checks. Thresholds, weights, invalid-output policy, and code are unknown. NAVSIM reports collision, drivable-area, time-to-collision, comfort, progress, and PDMS metrics, but DiffGRPO reward code is unreleased. LingoQA evaluation depends on an unspecified local classifier judge.

value_zh.html: 主 GRPO 对选择题推理使用精确答案匹配、框 IoU、点在掩码内与严格格式检查。阈值、权重、无效输出策略与代码未知。NAVSIM 报告碰撞、可行驶区域、碰撞时间、舒适性、进度与 PDMS 指标，但 DiffGRPO 奖励代码未发布。LingoQA 评测依赖于未指明的本地分类器评审。

value.html: Main RL success depends on answer equality, geometric overlap or containment, and format compliance under undisclosed thresholds. NAVSIM uses weighted offline metrics, not a disclosed hard terminal predicate. No physical task-completion or closed-loop deployment-safety contract is released.

value_zh.html: 主 RL 成功依赖于答案相等、几何重叠或包含，以及未披露阈值下的格式合规。NAVSIM 使用加权离线指标，而非已披露的硬终态谓词。未发布物理任务完成或闭环部署安全契约。

value.html: Vision encoder, projector, and LLM initialize from MiMo-VL 7B-SFT-2508. The checkpoint is branded 7B while Hugging Face displays 8B parameters. Intermediate Stage-1/2/3/4 and downstream planner checkpoints are not identified.

value_zh.html: 视觉编码器、投影器与 LLM 从 MiMo-VL 7B-SFT-2508 初始化。checkpoint 标为 7B，而 Hugging Face 显示 8B 参数。中间 Stage-1/2/3/4 与下游规划器 checkpoints 未标明。

value.html: DeepSeek-R1 supplies some long embodied reasoning. The Stage-3 CoT teacher is unknown. Expert drivers provide proprietary demonstrations. LingoQA evaluation uses an unspecified local text-classification judge, not a disclosed training teacher.

value_zh.html: DeepSeek-R1 提供部分长具身推理。Stage-3 CoT 教师未知。专家驾驶员提供专有示范。LingoQA 评测使用未指明的本地文本分类评审，而非已披露的训练教师。

value.html: Public/proprietary media are transformed into QA, grounding, action, reasoning, and trajectory records. Some sources use automatic QA; self-curated data create camera-coordinate 3D grounding; Stage 3 generates CoT; the downstream planner generates diffusion trajectories. Production code is unreleased.

value_zh.html: 公开/专有媒体被转换为 QA、锚定、动作、推理与轨迹记录。部分来源使用自动 QA；自策展数据创建相机坐标 3D 锚定；Stage 3 生成 CoT；下游规划器生成扩散轨迹。生产代码未发布。

value.html: Stage 1 mixes general and embodied data; Stage 2 carries them forward and adds driving; Stage 3 carries them forward and adds CoT; Stage 4 samples RL data. Ablations approximately equalize loss tokens. Exact mixtures, replay proportions, balancing, curricula, shuffle seeds, and total tokens are unknown.

value_zh.html: Stage 1 混合通用与具身数据；Stage 2 沿用并加入驾驶；Stage 3 沿用并加入 CoT；Stage 4 采样 RL 数据。消融大约均衡损失 tokens。精确混合物、回放比例、平衡、课程、打乱种子与总 tokens 未知。

value.html: Main GRPO and DiffGRPO rollout group sizes, prompts, attempted/retained outputs, steps, and total counts are unknown.

value_zh.html: 主 GRPO 与 DiffGRPO 的 rollout 组大小、提示、尝试/保留输出、步数与总计数未知。

value.html: Data generation, Stage-3 CoT, main GRPO, and DiffGRPO decoding are unknown. Public LingoQA evaluation uses temperature 0 only in that adapter.

value_zh.html: 数据生成、Stage-3 CoT、主 GRPO 与 DiffGRPO 解码未知。公开 LingoQA 评测仅在该适配器中使用 temperature 0。

value.html: The report names curated/high-quality subsets, filters short Cosmos-Reason1 videos, selects an EgoPlan-IT subset, and directs Stage-4 RL toward corner cases and prior failures. Thresholds, deduplication, privacy/safety filters, failure-mining rules, and retained/rejected counts are unknown.

value_zh.html: 报告点名策展/高质量子集，过滤短 Cosmos-Reason1 视频，选择 EgoPlan-IT 子集，并将 Stage-4 RL 导向边角案例与先前失败。阈值、去重、隐私/安全过滤器、失败挖掘规则与保留/拒绝计数未知。

value.html: All stages use 32,768 maximum sequence length. Current evaluation defaults include 4,096 image tokens, 4,096 per-video, 16,384 total video tokens, 2 FPS, at most 256 frames, and up to 32,768 generated tokens. Exact paper-run budgets and control frequency are unknown.

value_zh.html: 所有阶段使用 32,768 最大序列长度。当前评测默认包括 4,096 图像 tokens、每视频 4,096、总共 16,384 视频 tokens、2 FPS、最多 256 帧，以及最多 32,768 生成 tokens。精确论文运行预算与控制频率未知。

value.html: Stages 1-3 train all components with batch 512, AdamW, learning rate 2e-6, weight decay 0.05, cosine schedule, and 32,768 context. Stage 4 uses batch 32, AdamW, learning rate 1e-6, weight decay 0, cosine, and the same context. Steps, warmup, precision, KL, hardware, compute, and seeds are unknown.

value_zh.html: Stages 1-3 以 batch 512、AdamW、学习率 2e-6、weight decay 0.05、余弦日程与 32,768 上下文训练所有组件。Stage 4 使用 batch 32、AdamW、学习率 1e-6、weight decay 0、余弦与相同上下文。步数、warmup、精度、KL、硬件、算力与种子未知。

value.html: Many source families and stage order are named, but no selected samples, hours, frames, images, QA pairs, tokens, CoT traces, trajectories, RL rollouts, or per-source/domain ratios are disclosed. The proprietary driving set is merely called large scale.

value_zh.html: 点名了许多来源族与阶段顺序，但未披露所选样本、小时、帧、图像、QA 对、tokens、CoT 痕迹、轨迹、RL rollouts 或按来源/域比例。专有驾驶集仅被称为大规模。

value.html: No immutable stage or benchmark row manifest exists. Training and evaluation families overlap or share derivatives, including RoboRefIt, RoboAfford, EgoPlan, Cosmos-Reason1, EmbSpatial, RefSpatial, CODA-LM, DriveLM, MME-RealWorld, IDKB, and nuScenes/egocentric sources. Row, video, scene, route, subject, geography, and near-duplicate separation are unknown.

value_zh.html: 不存在不可变的阶段或基准行清单。训练与评测族重叠或共享衍生品，包括 RoboRefIt、RoboAfford、EgoPlan、Cosmos-Reason1、EmbSpatial、RefSpatial、CODA-LM、DriveLM、MME-RealWorld、IDKB 与 nuScenes/第一人称来源。行、视频、场景、路线、主体、地理与近重复分离未知。

value.html: No exact, perceptual, temporal, scene, route, translated, synthetic, or inherited MiMo-VL decontamination audit is disclosed. Shared media, derivative QA, benchmark variants, proprietary scenes, and development-time evaluation may overlap.

value_zh.html: 未披露精确、感知、时间、场景、路线、翻译、合成或继承的 MiMo-VL 去污染审计。共享媒体、派生 QA、基准变体、专有场景与开发时评测可能重叠。

items: Training scale and mixture ratios are absent.
Training and evaluation families overlap or share media, so contamination and cross-domain leakage remain unresolved.
Stage-3 CoT teacher, prompts, counts, correctness checks, and rejects are unknown.
Main rule rewards verify labels and formatting, not physical task success or safety.
NAVSIM IL+DiffGRPO reward, simulator revision, rollouts, code, and planner checkpoint are unreleased.
NAVSIM and proprietary trajectory results are offline/open-loop and do not establish closed-loop robustness or sim-to-real transfer.
Real-world robot evidence is qualitative target visualization, not controlled execution.
Proprietary sensor data omit scale, geography, dates, drivers, consent, faces/plates/location handling, retention, access, labor, and terms.
Open-loop L2 and limited front-frame inputs may hide multimodal futures and compounding control error.
LingoQA requires an unspecified Lingo-Judge-safetensors placeholder checkpoint and a 0.5 threshold.
The model is branded 7B while Hugging Face displays 8B.
Only final weights and evaluation code are public; training, failures, CoT/RL records, safety environments, and planner artifacts are closed.
训练规模与混合物比例缺失。
训练与评测族重叠或共享媒体，因此污染与跨域泄漏仍未解决。
继承的 MiMo-VL 暴露未经审计。
Stage-3 CoT 教师、提示、计数、正确性检查与拒绝项未知。
主规则奖励核验标签与格式，而非物理任务成功或安全。
NAVSIM IL+DiffGRPO 奖励、模拟器 revision、rollouts、代码与规划器 checkpoint 未发布。
NAVSIM 与专有轨迹结果为离线/开环，并不确立闭环稳健性或仿真到现实迁移。
真实世界机器人证据是定性目标可视化，而非受控执行。
专有传感器数据省略规模、地理、日期、驾驶员、同意、人脸/车牌/位置处理、保留、访问、劳动与条款。
开环 L2 与有限前帧输入可能掩盖多模式未来与累积控制误差。
LingoQA 需要未指明的 Lingo-Judge-safetensors 占位 checkpoint 与 0.5 阈值。
模型标为 7B，而 Hugging Face 显示 8B。
仅最终权重与评测代码公开；训练、失败、CoT/RL 记录、安全环境与规划器产物关闭。

value.html: Weights are labeled MIT; inherited evaluation code is MIT and Xiaomi additions Apache-2.0. These labels do not resolve rights to public/proprietary datasets, web or egocentric media, synthetic CoT, human annotation, camera records, trajectories, faces, plates, locations, or bystanders. No attribution, consent, privacy, retention, access, or takedown ledger is released.

value_zh.html: 权重标为 MIT；继承的评测代码为 MIT，Xiaomi 新增为 Apache-2.0。这些标签不解决对公开/专有数据集、网页或第一人称媒体、合成 CoT、人工标注、相机记录、轨迹、人脸、车牌、位置或旁观者的权利。未发布归属、同意、隐私、保留、访问或下架账本。

value.html: A four-stage graph plus separate planner training is recoverable, but source revision/media/row -> transformation/filter -> teacher output -> split -> reward/rollout -> batch -> checkpoint -> evaluation output joins are absent.
